title: Remington tool dead
fullDescription:
Remington tools include an ALCI plug. Press the Reset button on the plug. If still dead, the cord may have failed at strain relief, or the thermal fuse opened from a prior overheat.

ALCI Reset is solution to ~50% of cases.

fixSteps.title: Replace tool
fixSteps.instruction: Cord/fuse not user-serviceable; new tool cheaper.

faq.a: Small button on plug face — sometimes only visible side-on.

title: Remington straightener one plate cold
fullDescription:
Remington S5500/S6500 ProLuxe have one heater per plate. If only one heats, that heater has gone open circuit. Not user-serviceable — heater is bonded to plate.

New tool is most economical.

fixSteps.title: Confirm with quick touch
fixSteps.instruction: After 1 min on, both plates should be hot.

faq.a: Most Remington models 2-5 years; check serial.

title: ProLuxe display flashes temperature
fullDescription:
ProLuxe S9100 flashes set temperature when plates can't reach setpoint within 30s. Likely outlet voltage is low or one heater half failed.

Try another outlet first.

faq.a: Cheap adapters drop voltage — flashing common abroad.

title: Remington dryer airflow weak
fullDescription:
Remington Pro dryers have a removable rear filter. Lint accumulates and starves motor. Twist off, rinse, dry, refit.

If airflow stays weak, brushes are worn.

title: Remington shaver/clipper not charging
fullDescription:
Remington cordless tools use NiMH (older) or Li-ion (newer). Verify adapter, then leave on charger 24h to wake protect circuit.

NiMH packs past 3 years rarely recover.

fixSteps.title: Verify adapter
fixSteps.instruction: Multimeter on tip; match printed voltage.

title: Curling iron clamp seized
fullDescription:
Hair-spray residue gums the pivot bushing. Hot rinse and minute amount of high-temp silicone grease frees most.

Never WD-40.

fixSteps.title: Silicone grease
fixSteps.instruction: Tiny dab high-temp grease at pivot.

title: Remington shaver pulling/painful
fullDescription:
Remington recommends foil/cutter replacement every 12-18 months. F5/F7 series uses SP-FC service kit (foil + cutter). Hair pull means dull or cracked foils.

Replace as a kit.

title: Clipper blades skip/jam
fullDescription:
Remington HC series clippers need oiling every few uses. Misalignment also causes skipping — top blade should be 0.5mm behind bottom blade tip.

Clean, oil, align.

fixSteps.title: Realign
fixSteps.instruction: Loosen 2 screws, set top 0.5mm back, retighten.

title: Remington auto curler hair tangle
fullDescription:
Remington Curl Revolution / ProLuxe auto curlers stop and beep when hair won't release. Press chamber release; gently unwind.

Do not pull hair — heater can shift inside chamber.

title: Tool shuts off before 60 minutes
fullDescription:
Remington styling tools auto-shutoff at 60 minutes. Premature shutoff (<30 min) is the thermal safety reacting to plate buildup or clogged filter.

Clean and retry.
